show.description: Rhea, a poor girl abused by her family, narrowly escapes a horrific assault at a bar and crosses paths with billionaire Aman Sisodiya. Their lives intertwine after a fateful night leaves Rhea pregnant, forcing her into a contract marriage with Aman. Amid betrayal, conspiracies, and misunderstandings, Rhea fights for dignity while Aman struggles between doubt and love—until truth and redemption finally unite them as a family. Watch now.
